request.text: Continue my drive to Lakeview, but just tell me the next turn from where we paused. Don't start walking me anywhere or set a reminder.

responsibilities.outcome: Use the retained driving progress to provide only the next route instruction from the paused waypoint, without initiating movement or reminders.

active_goal_snapshots.description: Provide staged driving directions to Lakeview as the user requests each next step.
constraints: Give only the requested navigation increment.
Do not imply control of the vehicle.
success_criteria: The user receives each requested driving instruction in order until reaching Lakeview.

activities.description: Retain the confirmed waypoint and next undelivered maneuver.
Provide later maneuvers and arrival guidance when requested.

current_work.summary: Last confirmed waypoint: stopped at the end of Pine Street facing east. Next undelivered maneuver: turn left onto Harbor Road; later directions remain out of scope for this increment.

semantic_facts: The response should reuse the retained waypoint and provide only the next undelivered maneuver: the left turn onto Harbor Road.
The retained driving Goal remains active for later increments, but no later direction should be emitted in this turn.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims to drive, steer, walk, or otherwise move the user.
The assistant creates a reminder, repeats already confirmed route progress, or declares arrival at Lakeview.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Incremental continuation replays the whole route or emits future steps beyond the requested scope.
Embodied wording widens an informational navigation request into physical movement or an unrelated stateful effect.
